response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, district_id;
